latest_release.body:
## 6.3 - Magisk, KernelSU, APatch and device guides rewritten. Pick `boot`, `init_boot`, `vendor_boot` or recovery from the device layout, not the Android version. - Samsung uses the full AP-tar flow. First install wipes data and trips Knox for good. Do not restore individual stock partitions. - Temporary root split out properly. DirtyFrag (CVE-2026-43284) and GhostLock (CVE-2026-43499) are session-only: root ends on reboot, changed files can stay, failed runs can reboot the phone. - Device tables for temporary root now live in the maintained Awesome Temporary Root project. Added CVE-2026-98260 timer exploit warnings. - Collection passed 770 apps and modules, up from 700+. New entries include KazeSU, XECKernel Ultra, VD-Backup, Shellscaled, WireGuard Plus, VirtuMic and NexFusion. - Removed dead entries: Spotify Plus, Temporary-Root, Simple Flag Secure, ONextBox, the susfs4ksu LKM module, MMRL's F-Droid badge. - Fixed licenses and links: Encore Tweaks and WaEnhancer X, the WaEnhancer X repo, and a duplicate COPG-VD entry. - Universal GMS Doze Fork now warns that its installer and the Plus fork delete `gms` files across `/data/data`; Plus also disables Find My Device's admin receiver. - Store buttons redesigned. Play Store, F-Droid and IzzyOnDroid badges are inline SVG with visible labels, proper accessible names and keyboard focus styles. IzzyOnDroid is new. - **Play Store**:
- **F-Droid / IzzyOnDroid**:
- Article schema added for guides, app pages and a few standalone pages. Other pages use WebPage. - Publication dates come from one git log pass, with dates inherited through renames. No date is invented when history is missing. - Standalone pages share a sidebar: About, Contributing, Contact, Privacy, Legal, FAQ, Troubleshooting, Resources, Non-Root Alternatives. - Frontend slimmed down: `simple-icons` removed, GitHub and X marks inlined, Lucide icons imported per file. - Global error handler removed. Offline live region stays mounted. Old PWA workaround dropped now that upstream fixed it. - CI builds upload an artifact; a separate job deploys to Cloudflare Pages. Same-repo PRs get `pr-` preview deployments. - Jobs have timeouts. Bun cache keys include `.bun-version` and architecture. Runners are GitHub-hosted `ubuntu-latest` again, with Blacksmith checkout kept. - Codeberg mirror runs nightly, prunes deleted branches, and passes credentials through git config instead of the remote URL or command line. - `check_links.py` follows VitePress anchors (h2 to h4 duplicates, explicit `{#id}`) and skips fenced and inline code. - PR template asks for a link to the added project. AGENTS.md gained short modern-web guidance. - Dependencies bumped: Lucide, Vite PWA, vitepress-plugin-llms. Build runs VitePress from the repo root. ### APP and Modules count | Category | Count | | --- | ---: | | Total entries | 785 | | Root apps | 235 | | Magisk modules | 231 | | KernelSU modules | 150 | | APatch modules | 116 | | LSPosed modules | 312 | ### New Contributors * @readonlynux made their first contribution in https://github.com/awesome-android-root/awesome-android-root/pull/211 * @Najip made their first contribution in https://github.com/awesome-android-root/awesome-android-root/pull/217 * @VictorGabriel7Dev made their first contribution in https://github.com/awesome-android-root/awesome-android-root/pull/219 * @VD171 made their first contribution i

[![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-awesome--android--root.xyz%E2%86%97-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://awesome-android-root.xyz/) [![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/awesome-android-root/awesome-android-root?logo=github&style=for-the-badge&color=blue&cacheSeconds=3600)](https://github.com/awesome-android-root/awesome-android-root) [![Apps and Modules](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fawesome-android-root.xyz%2Fcount.json&query=%24.total&label=apps%20%26%20modules&color=blue&logo=android&style=for-the-badge)](https://awesome-android-root.xyz/apps-and-modules/) [![Codeberg Mirror](https://img.shields.io/badge/Codeberg-Mirror-2185D0?style=for-the-badge&logo=codeberg&logoColor=white)](https://codeberg.org/awesome-android-root/awesome-android-root/)

Start Here · Apps & Modules · Guides · Contributing · Community · License

--- ## What is Awesome Android Root? Awesome Android Root is a community-curated knowledge base for **rooting Android devices and making good use of root access**. It has three parts: | Part | What you get | | :--- | :--- | | **Rooting guides** | Magisk, KernelSU, APatch, LSPosed, bootloader unlocking, and device walkthroughs for Pixel, Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus, Nothing, and Motorola. | | **Apps & modules database** | 800+ curated entries with source links, store badges, and license info. | | **Tutorials, FAQs & fixes** | Ad blocking, debloating, Play Integrity, bootloop recovery, and more. | Every entry links to its primary source (GitHub, F-Droid, or the project site) and carries license and framework badges, so you can check a tool before you install it. ### Entry badges | Badge | Meaning | | :--- | :--- | | `[M]` | Works with Magisk | | `[K]` | Works with KernelSU | | `[A]` | Works with APatch | | `[LSP]` | LSPosed (Xposed) module | | `FOSS` / `Proprietary` | License type | | `⭐` | Widely trusted resource | ## Start Here New to rooting? Follow this order: 1. Read the [FAQ](docs/faqs.md) before you touch the bootloader. 2. Pick a path in the [Rooting Guides](docs/rooting-guides/index.md). 3. Keep [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md) open in case of a bootloop or a failed integrity check. 4. Not sure you want root? See the [Temporary Root](docs/rooting-guides/root-without-unlocking-bootloader.md) or [Non-Root Alternatives](docs/non-root-alternatives.md) (Shizuku, ADB, and more). ## Website The site is the easiest way to browse. It adds instant search across every app, module, and guide, per-category navigation, and installs as a PWA. **[Open awesome-android-root.xyz ↗](https://awesome-android-root.xyz)** ## Apps and Modules Entries live in [`docs/apps-and-modules/`](docs/apps-and-modules/index.md), the source of truth for the collection.
